full_scale.q15_conversion: signed int16 / 32768; never normalize by input peak

algorithm.welch: overlap_samples=floor(N*overlap); linear arithmetic mean; discard incomplete tail
algorithm.sidedness: complex: fftshift two-sided; real: one-sided, double interior bins only

nonfinite_policy: null in dB arrays means negative infinity (zero PSD). Linear PSD/frequency are finite. NaN/+Inf forbidden.
